title: Concept: MD5 use via hashlib.md5 (python) — review required
description: In python, hashlib.md5 computes MD5. Collision attacks let an attacker forge a second input with the same digest, which defeats signatures and integrity checks while leaving non-security checksums unaffected. The python-specific remedy is hashlib.sha256.
applicability: python codebases hashing data through hashlib.md5; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged integrity values and signatures when MD5 protects untrusted data; LOW severity as a default because checksum uses dominate, raised on review when the digest is security-relevant.
